name: DAPO

citation.title: DAPO: An Open-Source LLM Reinforcement Learning System at Scale

deltas.change: filter prompts whose groups have zero reward variance and resample until the batch is full
token-level policy-gradient loss (mean over all tokens in the batch rather than per-sequence averaging)
soft length-aware penalty for truncated/overlong completions
KL regularization term removed from the objective

notes: Four named techniques plus removal of the KL term, per the source paper.
